Original synthetic PDF fixtures, generated for W04, not factual product evidence. digital-scoped.pdf has two pages with explicit negation and a table-like text layout; empty-page.pdf has no extractable text. The baseline must never label the latter read or invent table cells. Generated using a minimal PDF object/xref writer independent of the extractor.
encrypted.pdf wraps the same original digital fixture with pypdf encryption and a synthetic test password; expected outcome is explicit unavailability, never attempted password discovery.
mixed-font-order.pdf draws the bold negation after the surrounding sentence in its content stream; geometric extraction must retain the negation in its physical sentence and preserve cell coordinates. This original regression was motivated by the real RFC9112 failure, without copying its text.
